subject: Request: temporary Net60 window & VAT routing for pilot
messages:
From: Martin Adler <martin.adler@lumohealth.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@lumohealth.com
Date: 2027-04-01T09:12:00Z
Subject: Request: temporary Net60 window & VAT handling for pilot

Hi Laura,

Quick one from procurement — our finance team is asking if Redwood can extend Net30 to Net60 for the upcoming pilot run with our EU biz unit. The ask is for a temporary 60-day payment window for the first 90 days of the engagement to align with our quarter-end cash planning.

Practical items they want confirmed before we raise a PO:
- A cap on outstanding credit during the pilot (suggested by our CFO: EUR 200k)
- Invoice routing instructions so VAT is charged to the correct LumoHealth legal entity in the EU
- Confirmation of any retainage / milestone withhold (if applicable)

We expect to send a PO once terms are agreed — can you advise what documentation Redwood needs (amendment, credit app, VAT evidence, etc.)?

Thanks — appreciate a quick turnaround, we want to get procurement moving.

Martin Adler
Head of Procurement | LumoHealth
martin.adler@lumohealth.com
+44 20 5555 0123

[Attachment: none]
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Martin Adler <martin.adler@lumohealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-01T14:25:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: temporary Net60 window & VAT handling for pilot

Hi Martin — thanks for the note and context. Short answer: we can support a temporary Net60 for a limited pilot, but it will be conditional on a few items so we can manage credit exposure and VAT compliance.

Proposed approach (90-day pilot):
- Temporary Net60 for invoices dated during the pilot window
- Credit cap: USD 200,000 (we can discuss currency conversion; will track in USD on our side)
- Required items before PO becomes billable: signed amendment to existing MSA (I attached a one-page draft), an approved PO referencing the amendment, and the EU VAT number / invoicing entity for LumoHealth
- Finance note: Redwood may hold a 10% milestone retainage on the first invoice until VAT evidence and PO are on file

Next steps from our side:
- Ben (AE) will coordinate the commercial amendment and finalize the cap;
- Kimberly (Finance) will kick off a quick credit check and confirm any documentation gaps;
- If LumoHealth can send the VAT certificate + PO this week we should be able to onboard the pilot under these temporary terms.

I attached a draft amendment to speed things up. Let us know if the EUR 200k cap works or if you need to propose a different figure and we'll review.

Best,

Laura Bennett
Head of Commercial Ops | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com | +1 415 555 0199

[Attachment: temporary_terms_amendment_v1.pdf]
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-02T10:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: temporary Net60 window & VAT handling for pilot (credit docs)

Laura / Ben — looping in finance requirements so procurement has a checklist. We can approve a temporary Net60 cap but need the following before we finalize:

1) Company legal name + EU VAT registration certificate (scanned PDF)
2) Purchase order referencing the Redwood amendment (we need PO number for invoicing)
3) Banking / remit-to instructions (IBAN for EU entity) and confirmation whether e-invoicing (Ariba/Peppol) is supported
4) Completed credit application (attached) — standard for any extended-term requests over $100k exposure
5) Copy of signed SOW or statement outlining pilot milestone schedule

Operational notes:
- If VAT is charged to your EU entity, ensure the invoice billing entity matches the VAT reg number; otherwise Redwood invoices net of VAT and the customer is responsible for local VAT accounting.
- We typically place a short 30-day early-pay incentive; if LumoHealth wants the full cap increased we can consider a 2% discount for Net30 on a future amendment.

I'll start the internal credit review once we have the docs; estimate 48 business hours after receipt. Attaching our credit application form.

Thanks,

Kimberly Park
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

[Attachment: credit_application_form.xlsx]
From: Martin Adler <martin.adler@lumohealth.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@lumohealth.com
Date: 2027-04-03T08:47:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: temporary Net60 window & VAT handling for pilot

Laura — thanks, that's helpful. Attaching our PO (PO_98765.pdf) and our EU VAT certificate for the LumoHealth Europe entity (LumoHealth_EU_VAT_cert.pdf).

A few quick clarifications from procurement/finance here:
- We'd prefer the credit cap to be EUR 250,000 rather than EUR 200,000. Can Redwood confirm whether that is manageable (we understand it may trigger a slightly longer credit check)?
- We'll sign the one-page amendment once finance confirms Redwood's checklist is complete.
- LumoHealth EU supports e-invoicing (via Peppol) and invoices should be sent to invoice@lumohealth-eu.com

If you can confirm receipt and next ETA for credit review we will push this PO through on our side today.

Best,

Martin Adler
Head of Procurement | LumoHealth
